TXT_DESCRIPTION: Paste a YouTube playlist link, preview it, and choose videos to create your own playlist.
TXT_URL_HELP: Use a public or unlisted playlist that opens with a link. Private playlists aren't supported.
MSG_INVALID_URL: Enter a YouTube playlist link with list=… in the address.
TXT_FETCH_PROGRESS: Getting the playlist and checking videos from YouTube. Long playlists may take a little longer.
TXT_START_HINT: Paste a link above to preview. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
TXT_FETCHED: Checked {count} / {total} entries in the YouTube playlist
TXT_WARNINGS: {unavailable, plural, one {# unavailable video} other {# unavailable videos}} · {skipped, plural, one {# skipped or duplicate entry} other {# skipped or duplicate entries}}.
TXT_UNAVAILABLE: This video can't be used in the app, so it can't be selected
TXT_EMPTY: This playlist has no videos yet. Try another link.
TXT_READY: Create a copy in your library
TXT_LOCAL_COPY: Rename, add, remove, and reorder tracks in this copy. The original YouTube playlist stays unchanged.
BTN_IMPORT: Import {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}
BTN_IMPORTING: Importing {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}…
TXT_IMPORT_PROGRESS: Checking and saving {count, plural, one {your selected video} other {your # selected videos}}. Keep this page open until it's finished.
TXT_SELECT_HINT: Select at least one video to continue.
TXT_SYNC_POLICY: Sync only adds new videos from YouTube and preserves your order. Tracks you removed or deselected during import won't be added again.
MSG_IMPORTED: Added {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} to your playlist.
MSG_SYNC_ADDED: Added {count, plural, one {# new video} other {# new videos}}. Your edits are preserved.
